verdict.rationale: Raygun is a hosted error-monitoring SaaS, and whether its source is openly licensed is a fair question for this kind of product, so the axis applies. The pack has no evidence that Raygun's own codebase is published under an open license. The only related item is a 2013 community remark that the client 'providers' (SDKs) are open source, which is adjacent rather than the product itself. A comparison comment also lists an open-source codebase as an advantage of Sentry over Raygun.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
